verdicts.reason: A drops every price, so the fare offer is gone. Its city labels are tiny and scattered down the left edge, the Berlin and Madrid labels sit in dark text on the blue panel where they can't be read, and the legal line is low-contrast on blue; only the headline and CTA survive. B keeps the prices but is chaotic: Berlin and Madrid are large while London and Paris are tiny, Rome is a speck at the panel's edge, Vienna sits stranded below the blue block, and the legal text is squeezed into a narrow column in the corner. It is still the less bad resize because it keeps the brand block, the CTA and the actual fares.
